statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; conditional Tail risk is concentrated around the U.S. cash open and the 14:00 UTC survey-and-speaker cluster.
headline: NQ retracement weakens one-way evidence while the U.S. event cluster keeps Stress extreme
body: Delayed December NQ has retraced from its session high to near the session low and sits slightly below its open, while VIX remains subdued and the 10-year yield is near 4.97%. Oil above $100 and a dense U.S. event cluster keep Stress extreme, but current price-path evidence does not show persistent mean-reversion failure.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours include Monday's technology-led one-way phase, with Tail peaking at 38% at 19:00 UTC, followed by sharp de-escalation after the cash session. The latest published 07:00 UTC assessment was 19% low Tail.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low-to-WATCH through Europe unless NQ develops persistent near-extreme holding or repeated failed retracements. Conditional risk concentrates around the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open and the 14:00-14:20 UTC Richmond/Williams/Jefferson cluster, then should de-escalate if price discovery becomes two-way.

forecast.analysis: Observed current structure is two-way: delayed December NQ is 30,771.75, slightly below its 30,813 open and near the 30,761 session low after reaching 30,844.50. That retracement argues against a persistent no-mean-reversion path despite firm AI sentiment.

forecast.analysis: If European trade stays rotational rather than pinning NQ at an extreme, Tail remains low. A renewed directional push with shallow pullbacks would be the first escalation checkpoint.
WATCH becomes conditional if U.S. premarket liquidity develops repeated extension after failed retracements. Continued two-way rotation would keep the path below the block threshold.
As the Europe-to-U.S. handoff develops, Tail rises modestly only if NQ holds near an extreme and retracement attempts repeatedly fail. Balanced handoff structure would cap risk.
Pre-open Stress is high because the cash open and 14:00 UTC event cluster approach. Tail remains WATCH unless price structure is already stretched and mean reversion is visibly failing.
drivers: Richmond survey and Fed remarks ahead

forecast.analysis: The 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open falls in this hour. Elevated Tail is conditional on opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks, repeated extensions, or near-extreme holding.

Richmond business surveys, Williams at 14:05 UTC and Jefferson at 14:20 UTC cluster here. Elevated Tail requires an observed one-way response or delayed second leg; the events alone do not establish it.
Post-event Tail stays elevated only if the first move extends after failed retracements. Orderly price discovery, deeper pullbacks or cross-asset stabilization would argue for rapid de-escalation.
After the primary event window, WATCH remains conditional on NQ still holding near an extreme with directional efficiency. Broader rotation would reduce Tail while Stress stays high.
Residual event repricing could keep Stress elevated. Tail remains below block unless price action again becomes one-way with shallow or failed retracements.
Mid-afternoon risk should continue to normalize if earlier moves have been retraced. A renewed extension without meaningful pullback would be the main condition for higher Tail.
The 19:00-20:00 UTC power hour can amplify an established trend. WATCH is conditional on persistent closing-direction pressure and weak retracement rather than the clock alone.
After the U.S. cash close, Tail returns to a low baseline if the session ends with two-way trade or a meaningful retracement. Unresolved extreme-holding would keep residual risk higher.
CME equity-index futures maintenance reduces live price discovery during 21:00-22:00 UTC. Tail is low because no future directional path is assumed through the maintenance interval.
At the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen, Tail is conditional on whether reopening gaps extend without retracement. A balanced restart would keep risk low despite residual headline sensitivity.
Early overnight trade remains low Tail unless the reopen develops sustained directional efficiency. Headline-driven gaps matter mainly if they persist after attempts to mean-revert.
During early Asia hours, absent a fresh catalyst, the baseline is normal-to-mixed. Tail would rise only if NQ becomes pinned to an extreme with repeated failed pullbacks.
A quiet Asia session would favor low Tail as liquidity rebuilds. A sudden oil, geopolitical or technology shock would primarily lift Stress until persistent price-path evidence appears.
Without a fresh catalyst, mean-reverting overnight trade keeps Tail low. Directional conviction would require consistent extension rather than isolated volatility.
Late Asia trade remains a low-Tail baseline if ranges stay balanced. A one-way move into the Europe handoff would be the relevant escalation condition.
Ahead of Europe, Tail remains low if overnight extremes are not being persistently defended. Break-and-hold behavior with weak pullbacks would raise the next-session checkpoint.
As European participation starts to build, Tail edges higher only conditionally on a clean trend that survives retracement attempts. Otherwise the overnight baseline remains mixed.
Pre-cash Europe can increase directional conviction if technology leadership and NQ align while pullbacks stay shallow. Divergence between sectors or assets would cap Tail.
The next European cash open is a fresh structure checkpoint. Tail remains below WATCH unless opening flow produces persistent near-extreme holding or repeated failed retracements.
